preconditions.description: The number of rows (and columns) in the board is between 3 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output consists of n lines, each with n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for line in output for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either 'W' or 'B'.

postconditions.expression: sum(line.count('W') for line in output) == n
postconditions.description: There are n white knights in the output.

postconditions.expression: sum(line.count('B') for line in output) == n
postconditions.description: There are n black knights in the output.
The number of duels in the output is the maximum possible.

invariants.description: The number of duels in the output does not exceed the maximum possible number of duels.
